paper_metadata.title: High-strength Mg93.96Zn2Y4Sr0.04 alloy with long-period stacking ordered structure

evidence.quote: The deformation behavior and microstructure evolution of a high-strength Mg 93.96Zn2Y4Sr0.04 (at%) alloy with long-period stacking ordered (LPSO) structure subjected to equal channel angular pressing (ECAP) were systematically investigated.

parameters.atmosphere: CH2FCF3 (2.6 vol%) and N2 (97.4 vol%) mixed protective gas

process_steps.input_state: high-purity Mg, Zn, Y and Mg-10Sr (wt%) master alloy

evidence.quote: The Mg 93.96Zn2Y4Sr0.04 alloy was obtained from a high-purity Mg, Zn, Y and Mg–10Sr (wt%) master alloy through induction melting in a mild steel crucible under a mixed protective gas atmosphere of CH2FCF3 (2.6 vol%) and N2 (97.4 vol%) at 770 1C.
A high-strength Mg93.96Zn2Y4Sr0.04 alloy was developed successfully by conventional permanent mold casting combined with ECAP processing.
The samples were subjected to 4 passes of ECAP via route BC at 330 1C with an extrusion speed of 2 mm/min.
